lines.trans: Come on, I do not even know such illnesses.
Your body is very weak.
And your heart is weak.
A stroke does not pass without consequences.
And hallucinations do not appear out of nowhere.
And how much time do I have left?
Maybe five years, or maybe a year.
You need to quit your job.
Quit completely?
Cook calmly at home in your own kitchen.
But no stresses at work.
I heard you.
